what: On first open, a logo at the center of the accent-color curtain flips once on the X axis. It lies at −90° from below (100%), stands up over 1s power3, then flips 90° up to (−80%) over 1s. At the .5s mark of the first 1s, the curtain begins to clear from bottom to top by clip, fully cleared by 2s expo.inOut. fx:lift fires when clearing starts (the moment to raise the hero photo and text), and fx:done when fully cleared

options.flip: Time for the logo to stand up and move on (sec, one side), default 1
options.delay: Delay before start (s), default 0 — the original starts only after the window finishes loading

note: Turning off the white transition cover (background color) under the curtain at 1s power1 as well lets the background show first through the clearing gap, like the original — that is done on the user side in fx:lift
